summary: Tested photo/file serving endpoints and frontend visibility. All backend APIs working correctly (10/10 tests passed). Frontend admin view shows photos in First Visit tab with folder organization. Customer portal shows all 12 first visit photos and 7 3D designs correctly.
seed_data_creation: Used existing project PROJ-8DC83A0F with 12 first visit photos and 7 3D design files
context_for_next_testing_agent: Photo serving endpoints are working correctly. /api/static/first_visit/{project_id}/{filename} serves first visit photos. /api/uploads/designs/{project_id}/{filename} serves 3D design files. Customer portal route is /klant/:accessToken (not /customer-portal/:accessToken).

GET /api/static/first_visit/{project_id}.details: Returns 200 with correct content-type (image/jpeg) for existing photos

GET /api/uploads/designs/{project_id}/{f.details: Returns 200 with correct content-type (image/png) for design files

GET /api/static/designs/{project_id}/{fi.details: Alternative route also works for design files

Non-existent file returns 404.details: Returns 404 for files that don't exist

Project API returns correct photo URLs.details: first_visit_photos array contains objects with url field pointing to /api/static/first_visit/...

Project API returns correct design URLs.details: design_3d_files array contains objects with url field pointing to /api/uploads/designs/...

Frontend: First Visit tab shows photos.details: Shows '12 foto's in 4 mappen' with folder organization by room (Badkamer, Keuken, Woonkamer, Slaapkamer)

Frontend: 3D Ontwerpen tab shows designs.details: Shows '7 bestanden in 4 mappen' with folder organization by room

Customer Portal: Photos visible.details: All 12 first visit photos displayed in grid layout with images loading correctly

Customer Portal: 3D Designs visible.details: All 7 3D design files displayed with room labels (Keuken, Woonkamer, Slaapkamer, Badkamer)

ui_verification.admin_login: PASS - Admin login with username/password works correctly
ui_verification.project_navigation: PASS - Can navigate to project detail page via /projects route
ui_verification.first_visit_tab: PASS - Shows photo count and folder structure
ui_verification.3d_designs_tab: PASS - Shows design count and folder structure
ui_verification.customer_portal_overview: PASS - Shows project status and quick stats
ui_verification.customer_portal_photos: PASS - All photos load correctly in grid
ui_verification.customer_portal_designs: PASS - All designs load with room labels

notes: The customer portal route is /klant/:accessToken, not /customer-portal/:accessToken. The API endpoint /api/customer-portal/:token works correctly but the frontend route uses /klant/.
